messages.subject: Aims and scope of this group
messages.subject_clean: Aims and scope of this group
messages.body_plain:
Welcome to the camtrapR user group!

This group is an offer to all users of camtrapR and everyone interested in using it.

It can be a place to discuss anything related to camtrapR, be it specific problems or bugs you encounter, the concepts and ideas the package applies, or general issues in camera trap data management.
We can that way hopefully improve the package and further increase its usefulness to you, the users.

Because this group is for you, please leave your comments and thoughts on how we can make the most out of this group, or be the first to post a new topic!

I sincerely hope that you will find this group useful.

Thanks for your interest in camtrapR!
Best regards,
Jürgen

messages.subject: camtrapR version 0.99.6 released today
messages.body_plain:
Today the new version of camtrapR (0.99.6) was released on CRAN.

Here's the news section of the new release:

Changes in camtrapR 0.99.6
=======================

bugfixes
------------
 o fixed crash in cameraOperation function caused by underscores in station / camera IDs

new functions
------------
 o fixDateTimeOriginal: Makes DateTimeOriginal Exif metadata tag in Reconyx Hyperfire cameras readable

new features
------------
  o spatialDetectionHistory: argument 'sessionCol' can now create multi-session capthist objects by either assigning individuals to different sessions or assigning stations to different sessions
  o exifTagNames: gained argument 'returnTagGroup', and now by default returns metadata tag group in addition to metadata tag names (to unambiguously address specific metadata tags)

other changes
------------
  o new dependency: "ritis" - this is because parts of package taxize (used internally by function "checkSpeciesNames") were migrated to ritis (forgot to add this to package NEWS section... sorry!)
  o detectionHistory / spatialDetectionHistory: occasionLength can be any value between 1 and the number of columns in camOp (not half the number of columns in camOp as before)
  o functions check for spaces in user-provided column names and report them as errors

messages.subject: Re: recordTable: Generate a species record table from camera trap images
messages.subject_clean: recordTable: Generate a species record table from camera trap images
messages.body_plain:
Hi Camille,
this problem may have to do with your "inDir" argument.
You currently use a relative path. inDir = "images_renamed" is equivalent to inDir = file.path(getwd(), "images_renamed"). The function thus assumes that "images_renamed" is a subdirectory of your current working directory. If it is not, the function cannot find the folder "images_renamed" and thus finds no JPG images in the place you specified. The error message comes from the function that reads out and tabulates the Exif metadata. But it did not find any image metadata ('data' must be of a vector type, was 'NULL'), and therefore can't tabulate anything. My apologies for the cryptic error message. Will be improved in the next package version.

The first thing you should try is to specify the absolute path (e.g. "C:/.../.../images_renamed", with your actual folder names instead of ...).Alternatively, use setwd() before running the recordTable function.

Please let me know if the error persists.

Best regards,
Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: Simple problem with recordTable
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
you are right. It looks as if stationChoyam contains images, but none of them has a 'Species' tag.

Here's an easy way out: you could assign a 'Species' tag like 'empty' to all images without a species record. These could then either be ignored by including them in argument 'exclude' of function recordTable (so they will not appear in the record table), or you manually remove them from the record table after running the function.
I would not recommend manually removing the directories that cause this problem, as I feel it is too error-prone and time-consuming.

I think the error is not really necessary here and can be downgraded to a warning, in effect skipping the station without breaking the function.
This will be changed in the next version. Thanks for the notification!
Best regards,
Jürgen
